item.title: GuocoLand proposes to take Malaysia unit private at a premium
item.description: Singapore-listed real estate investment and development group GuocoLand Limited is looking to privatise Kuala Lumpur-listed GuocoLand (Malaysia) Berhad (GLM), according to bourse announcements filed on Feb 3. Entitled shareholders of GLM will receive RM1.10 (about $0.35) in cash per ordinary share, under the proposed privatisation. item.title: Private credit gains ground in Asia Pacific real estate
item.description: Private credit is gaining traction in Asia Pacific (Apac) real estate as investors — including institutional investors, family offices and ultra-high-net-worth individuals — explore new opportunities while property developers adapt to rising costs. This comes as investors are looking to diversify their ways of accessing real estate exposure and equity returns are coming under pressure, making debt positions more attractive, says global real estate investment manager LaSalle Investment Management

item.title: Landed homes market puts up strong 4Q2025 performance, bolstered by upgraders: analysts
item.description: The landed residential property market showed a stronger performance in the last quarter of 2025, backed by healthy demand, according to market analysts. Research compiled by Huttons Asia shows that 482 landed homes (excluding Good Class Bungalows, or GCBs, and strata landed homes) changed hands in 4Q2025, 7.6% higher than in the previous quarter. item.title: River Valley condos combine centrality, demand and relative affordability
item.description: Singapore is divided into 55 planning areas, which are further grouped into five regions. Through careful and thoughtful planning by URA, many of these planning areas have gradually evolved and developed their own distinctive character. The River Valley Planning Area is part of Singapore’s Central Region and is slated for significant changes under the latest Master Plan. item.title: Mitsubishi Estate Asia puts 49.9% stake in Australian land lease venture up for sale
item.description: Mitsubishi Estate Asia (MEA) is looking to sell its stake in a portfolio of land lease communities in Australia. A land lease community refers to a residential development where the ownership of the home is separated from the land it occupies. Residents own their home but lease the land from the community operator, allowing for lower upfront costs. In Australia, the model is primarily adopted for housing targeted at seniors and retirees. item.title: Over 9,000 flats launched for sale in February BTO and SBF exercises
item.description: HDB has launched 9,012 flats for sale under the February Build-To-Order (BTO) flats and Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercises. A total of 4,692 BTO flats are up for sale across six projects in Bukit Merah, Sembawang, Tampines and Toa Payoh, along with 4,320 balance flats, located islandwide.
